## Test

```bash
npm test
```

`npm test` runs the whole Vitest suite: the colocated unit tests under `src/**` and the
cross-module integration tests under `tests/**` (`course-data-validation` checks 10 courses x 9
holes; the rest cover physics helpers, the leaderboard and the save manager). Focused subsets:

```bash
npm run test:ui      # UI layer (src/ui)
npm run test:input   # input and developer tools (src/input, src/dev)
npm run test:camera  # camera system (src/camera)
npm run test:watch   # re-run affected tests on change
```

Every suite in the repository runs under Vitest: there is no second runner and no compile step in
front of the tests.

## Known gaps

- The entry point does not assemble the gameplay loop: no hole scene, physics step, shot input, turn order or HUD.
- `?course` and `?hole` are recorded in the DOM but start nothing.
- Menu settings and the profile screen show placeholder data and are not persisted through `SaveManager`.
- No audio binaries ship with the repository; the game runs silently by design.
